summary: Blend it! What do funky bathrooms and your Nutribullet have in common? Our Latest Get The Look Collection explains..
title: Get The Look - Collection Two
bodyHtml:
Blend It!

Hello Bathroom Enthusiast,

In our industry a sure fire way of delivering a winning aesthetic is picking a tone or colour scheme and sticking with it across as many elements as possible. But if you’ve fallen in love with prize pieces that at first glance seem to clash, don’t despair!

If you take a minute to examine our latest get the look bathroom we’ve used products in colours and finishes that typically wouldn’t live in the same bathroom:

  • Gloss White
  • Polished Chrome
  • Matte Black
  • Matte White
  • Timber wall hung shelf


Not to mention the Aqua fish scale wall tiles!
